remake: node dev-tools/build_word_sounds_wordlist.cjs --cyplex <path to main_cyplex79.csv>, then copy the printed words, bytes and sha256 into "filtered" above. The original is not kept in the repo (9.3 MB).
scope: How often a word form appears in 400 books popular with children aged 7 to 9 in the United Kingdom. Used only to decide whether a word is familiar enough to offer as a practice word.
limitations: British books: British spellings and words score high (colour, mum), which is why data/word_sounds_british_en.txt exists. The youngest band is ages 7-9, so this is weak evidence for kindergarten and grade 1: it shows a word is common in books for slightly older children, not that a five-year-old knows it. All word forms are lower case, so names of characters score like ordinary words (the book count helps: a name is usually in few books). It counts printed forms, not meanings, and says nothing about whether a word is suitable. A word added to the sound dictionary later has no value until the file is re-made from the original.
